adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is explicitly lowercased (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`), but the filter compares against the raw `guest` string (`!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`), so a different-cased email can bypass the blacklist. The duplicate check against existing attendees is also case-sensitive (`guest === attendee.email`), allowing `Bob@x.com` to be added even if `bob@x.com` already exists. This is directly visible in the `uniqueGuests` filter logic.
